newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp, KN form joint marketing venture.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp, KN form joint marketing venture.

text.p: PacifiCorp and KN Energy Inc announced Thursday the formation of a joint venture to market to U.S. utilities a package of energy, communications and "infotainment" options.
The new company, which will be called en*able, will provide a portfolio of branded products and services that local utilities can offer to their customers on one consolidated bill.

KN Energy, an integrated gas company, and PacifiCorp, a global electric utility, said the venture is aimed at reshaping the way utilities operate in the face of challenges posed by the rapid restructuring of the energy industry.
In early January, PacifiCorp and KN Energy purchased Orcom Systems, a privately held company in Bend, Ore., which designs and implements billing and information systems using an IBM platform.

Fred Buckman, PacifiCorp chief executive officer said, "We're providing utilities throughout the country with an aggressive and competitive platform that will foster their success in a changing environment."

Larry Hall, KN Energy chairman, said, "Through this joint venture with PacifiCorp, we will accelerate our leadership position in the marketplace. Together, our approach is quite different: we want to be partners and suppliers to other utility companies, as opposed to those in our industry who are attempting to take over other markets and customers."
Hall will serve as chairman of en*able and named Mort Aaronson president and chief operating officer.
The company will be located in Lakewood, Colo., where KN Energy is headquartered.
